# 74181 - Arithmetic logic unit/function generator

Package DIP-24 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/74181.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/74181.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 36 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![74181 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/74181.png) | ![74181 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-74181.png) | ![74181 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-74181.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 9,10,11,13 | F(i)' = U(i) XOR L(i) XOR K(i), see behaviour | Each F output is one bit of the result chosen by the function table. The gate-level formulas are transcribed in behaviour from the functional block diagram (page 7-280) and checked against Table 2 for add, add with carry, subtract, XOR and AND on all 256 input pairs. |
| 16 | Cn+4 = carry out of the 4-bit arithmetic operation selected by S3..S0 with M low | Ripple carry output. With active-high data (Table 2) a low at Cn+4' means carry. Used as a magnitude comparator in subtract mode, see the last rule in state. |
| 15 | /P = carry propagate of the 4-bit group (for the '182) | Group propagate output; feeds a P input of the SN74182. |
| 17 | /G = carry generate of the 4-bit group (for the '182) | Group generate output; feeds a G input of the SN74182. |
| 14 | A=B = F0 AND F1 AND F2 AND F3 | Decoded from the function outputs (an AND of the four F lines in the block diagram); goes high (off) when all F outputs are high, i.e. A = B when the ALU is in subtract mode with Cn = H. |

## Stored state

Bits stored: 0

Changes on: combinational (no memory); this block holds the datasheet function tables

- Table 1, ACTIVE-LOW DATA. Columns: S3 S2 S1 S0 \| M=H logic \| M=L, Cn=L (no carry) \| M=L, Cn=H (with carry)
- L L L L \| F = A' \| F = A MINUS 1 \| F = A
- L L L H \| F = (AB)' \| F = AB MINUS 1 \| F = AB
- L L H L \| F = A' + B \| F = AB' MINUS 1 \| F = AB'
- L L H H \| F = 1 \| F = MINUS 1 (2's COMP) \| F = ZERO
- L H L L \| F = (A + B)' \| F = A PLUS (A + B') \| F = A PLUS (A + B') PLUS 1
- L H L H \| F = B' \| F = AB PLUS (A + B') \| F = AB PLUS (A + B') PLUS 1
- L H H L \| F = (A XOR B)' \| F = A MINUS B MINUS 1 \| F = A MINUS B
- L H H H \| F = A + B' \| F = A + B' \| F = (A + B') PLUS 1
- H L L L \| F = A'B \| F = A PLUS (A + B) \| F = A PLUS (A + B) PLUS 1
- H L L H \| F = A XOR B \| F = A PLUS B \| F = A PLUS B PLUS 1
- H L H L \| F = B \| F = AB' PLUS (A + B) \| F = AB' PLUS (A + B) PLUS 1
- H L H H \| F = A + B \| F = (A + B) \| F = (A + B) PLUS 1
- H H L L \| F = 0 \| F = A PLUS A (*) \| F = A PLUS A PLUS 1
- H H L H \| F = AB' \| F = AB PLUS A \| F = AB PLUS A PLUS 1
- H H H L \| F = AB \| F = AB' PLUS A \| F = AB' PLUS A PLUS 1
- H H H H \| F = A \| F = A \| F = A PLUS 1
- Table 2, ACTIVE-HIGH DATA. Columns: S3 S2 S1 S0 \| M=H logic \| M=L, Cn'=H (no carry) \| M=L, Cn'=L (with carry)
- L L L L \| F = A' \| F = A \| F = A PLUS 1
- L L L H \| F = (A + B)' \| F = A + B \| F = (A + B) PLUS 1
- L L H L \| F = A'B \| F = A + B' \| F = (A + B') PLUS 1
- L L H H \| F = 0 \| F = MINUS 1 (2's COMPL) \| F = ZERO
- L H L L \| F = (AB)' \| F = A PLUS AB' \| F = A PLUS AB' PLUS 1
- L H L H \| F = B' \| F = (A + B) PLUS AB' \| F = (A + B) PLUS AB' PLUS 1
- L H H L \| F = A XOR B \| F = A MINUS B MINUS 1 \| F = A MINUS B
- L H H H \| F = AB' \| F = AB' MINUS 1 \| F = AB'
- H L L L \| F = A' + B \| F = A PLUS AB \| F = A PLUS AB PLUS 1
- H L L H \| F = (A XOR B)' \| F = A PLUS B \| F = A PLUS B PLUS 1
- H L H L \| F = B \| F = (A + B') PLUS AB \| F = (A + B') PLUS AB PLUS 1
- H L H H \| F = AB \| F = AB MINUS 1 \| F = AB
- H H L L \| F = 1 \| F = A PLUS A (*) \| F = A PLUS A PLUS 1
- H H L H \| F = A + B' \| F = (A + B) PLUS A \| F = (A + B) PLUS A PLUS 1
- H H H L \| F = A + B \| F = (A + B') PLUS A \| F = (A + B') PLUS A PLUS 1
- H H H H \| F = A \| F = A MINUS 1 \| F = A
- (*) Each bit is shifted to the next more significant position.
- Comparator use (subtract mode S3..S0 = L,H,H,L): Cn=H, Cn+4=H -&gt; A &gt;= B (active-low data) / A &lt;= B (active-high); Cn=H, Cn+4=L -&gt; A &lt; B / A &gt; B; Cn=L, Cn+4=H -&gt; A &gt; B / A &lt; B; Cn=L, Cn+4=L -&gt; A &lt;= B / A &gt;= B

## Not known

- No separate maximum pull-up voltage for the open-collector A=B output beyond the 5.5 V IOH test condition.
- No minimum propagation delays printed.

## Notes

Pin 2/1/23/... names are for active-low data (Table 1); with active-high data the same pins are A0, B0, ... F0..F3, Cn', Cn+4', X (pin 15), Y (pin 17) and Table 2 applies. Subtraction is 1's complement plus forced carry.
